qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r6/raw-evidence-index.json; qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/functional-before.json (sha 9962bd4c..., matches index) and functional-after.json (sha e5dee33a..., matches index)
evidence: Every plural/exclusive public ask is graded over its whole (small, fully enumerated) collection. (1) 'everywhere a message appears: thread, reply's quote, search snippets, earlier versions, transcripts' (conversations.md Formatting): safe_formatting leg 2 checks thread, reply quote, search snippet and transcript; edits_and_stale_edit A1 checks the literal earlier version. (2) Wall 'by any route' list (walls-and-retention.md): wall_every_route legs 1-5 cover list, search+snippet/count, thread/transcript/search replays, direct transcript address and cross-matter reply (quote route); wall_mentions_and_links covers mentions, pasted link and @-suggestions. (3) 'suggests ... only them': M-12 suggestions must include Sian and Paul and never Dev or Gwen, M-11 never Paul - i.e. every non-eligible account for each matter is excluded (seed: 5 accounts, Dev walled from M-12, Paul client of M-12 only), while Harriet self-suggestion is left free so a conforming app is not punished. (4) 'appear only once' / 'same order wherever you see them: thread, search, transcript': sent_once_in_order checks exactly-once in thread, search and transcript, and order C,A,B in thread for two users after reloads, search and transcript. (5) 'A hold covers exactly that message': hold_scope_and_release leg 2 checks parent H0 and grandchild H1C are not held. (6) Retention 'whatever is now too old': for M-13 at 7 days the seed's only non-held messages >=7 days old are K-18 (JUDGE-TE edit) and K-13 (probate) - both required gone, held K-7 required to stay, and K-8 'Draft will sent for your review.' (2 days old), used by later criteria, legitimately survives; M-11 exactly-7-day K-10 vs K-11 at +1 s boundary both checked. (7) Transcript 'each with its author, sent time' -> search_and_transcript B2 says 'each message shows its author, and each shows its own sent time'; 'each version' for the only held edited message K-2. (8) Unread 'same in every tab' -> both Dev contexts checked in legs 1-3. (9) Signed-out 'no matter, message, mention or transcript data' -> each recorded request (list, thread, mentions, search) plus transcript address replayed. Negative search assertions use seed-unique strings: 'original lease scan' (K-1 only), 'rent review date' (K-10 only), 'Probate'/'2,400'/'4,200' (K-13 only), 'Insurer letter' (K-17 only), 'Fenwick'/'heads of terms' (M-12 only), so absolute 'finds nothing' guards cannot be tripped by legitimate other content; search Part C negatives (Q2 for '100%', Q4 for 'A_1', Q6 for 'X*9') are text-disjoint. 'Unchanged' guards tolerate legitimate side-effects: unread leg 4 uses 'at least 2' for Gwen; timer leg 2 accepts not-available, error or empty list for the deleted message's versions; persistence compares items noted immediately before restart with a fixed clock (no timer can fire between), so exact Dev count/'Survey booked' count are stable; refusal 're-read matches previous state' guards (timer 30 days, 'Version two JUDGE-E1', JUDGE-X1/H1 stay) concern only the refused operation. Scripted golden (not a configured judge run) passed all 16 functional + persistence_before/after and the 6 polish checks (functional-before.json / functional-after.json, hashes match the index). Non-blocking observations (no defect): 'Only a partner' timer/hold/wall and author-only edit refusals are exercised with one non-partner role (associate Sian), not also a client; the plausible bugs (staff-vs-partner, any-user edit) are caught by that associate, and only a contrived associate-blacklist would slip through. live_updates 'thread has not jumped to a different place' is a semantic guard, not an exact scrollTop equality, so content inserted near the viewport does not by itself fail a conforming app. Broken app tried: one that removes only the first too-old message on shortening (fails, both K-18 and K-13 required gone); one that hides M-12 in the list but leaks in search snippets (fails leg 2). Conforming alternative tried: app that does not suggest the author herself, or returns empty versions list after deletion - both accepted.
